title: Glycemia study protocol
text: The trial enrolled adults aged 18 to 75 years with diagnosed type 2 diabetes. The primary outcome was change in glycated hemoglobin after 24 weeks of treatment.

title: Safety monitoring plan
text: Participants report nausea, diarrhea, or abdominal discomfort at each follow-up visit. Investigators assess adverse events during scheduled visits at weeks 4, 12, and 24.
